value: blue light at night (16W + 8B) also increased pepper internode length, but to a lesser extent than blue plus far-red (16W + 8BFR) or far-red (16W + 8FR) at night
method: greenhouse pepper under 16 h white daytime light (6:00 to 22:00) followed by an 8 h night treatment (22:00 to 6:00): control 16W (darkness at night), continuous white light (24W), blue at night (16W + 8B), blue plus far-red at night (16W + 8BFR), far-red at night (16W + 8FR, Experiment 2); internode length measured at two harvests
conditions: Experiment 2: cultivars Maureno, Gina and Eurix, 40 plants per cultivar per treatment, destructive measurements on 10 plants per cultivar at 37 to 39 days in treatment and 6 per cultivar at 64 to 66 days; internode data come from Experiment 2 only (Experiment 1, Maureno only, 72 plants per treatment, had no destructive harvest); at 37 to 39 days internode length was similar between 16W, 24W and 16W + 8B in all cultivars, and 16W + 8B internodes were longer than 16W only at 64 to 66 days; DLI was matched across treatments, so night-lit treatments had lower daytime PAR (Experiment 2 Table 1: 180 for 16W, 153 for 16W + 8B, 152 for 16W + 8BFR, 182 for 16W + 8FR umol m-2 s-1); night flux was not matched across qualities (16W + 8B 55 PAR and no FR; 16W + 8BFR 56 PAR plus 11 FR; 16W + 8FR 10 FR only; night PSS 0.566, 0.315, 0.186); Tukey-Kramer adjusted comparisons at 0.05, individual p values not printed

source.authors: Lanoue J, Little C, Hao X
source.title: The Power of Far-Red Light at Night: Photomorphogenic, Physiological, and Yield Response in Pepper During Dynamic 24 Hour Lighting

quote: The 16W + 8B treatment also increased internode length but to a lesser extent than 16W + 8BFR and 16W + 8FR.
note: Night-time light quality comparison against a dark-night control; the paper reads these as photomorphogenic responses, but this record logs only the internode endpoint and no photoreceptor is identified. Same abstract: 16W + 8B and 16W + 8BFR drove photosynthesis at night and gave a yield similar to 16W; continuous white light (24W) significantly reduced fruit production and Fv/Fm. Results note that in 'Eurix' 16W + 8FR produced taller plants than 16W + 8BFR.
